data.body: `LAYER_NAME` (`aws-durable-execution-sdk-java-otel-plugin`) is a single, fixed-name, multi-region AWS resource, but the concurrency group is keyed by `github.sha`. A release-triggered run (source_ref/sha of the release tag) and a `workflow_dispatch` run from `main` (current HEAD sha) — or two releases published close together — will have different `github.sha` values and therefore execute concurrently. Both would independently run `list-layer-versions` → `publish-layer-version` → `add-layer-version-permission` against the same layer name in every configured region at the same time. Because two concurrent runs can each observe "no existing version with this description" before either publishes, both can call `publish-layer-version`, creating duplicate versions with identical `Description` text — breaking the idempotency invariant the rest of the script relies on (the reuse-lookup only reads the first matching line). Use a static group name, e.g. `lambda-layer-publish`, so all publish runs against this shared layer are fully serialized instead of keyed per commit.
